summary: Comprehensive testing of Admin Clinic Applications Management page at /admin/clinic-applications. All core features working: table view with clinic_name/city/contact_name/services/status/date columns, status filter cards with correct counts, search functionality, detail modal with all submitted data sections, status update buttons (Pending/Approved/Rejected/Waiting List), admin notes with save functionality. Backend APIs (GET/PATCH) fully functional. 16/18 backend tests passed (2 failures due to legacy data with old status 'new' and missing service fields).

minor.issue: One legacy application has status 'new' instead of 'pending' - data migration needed
One legacy application (Тест Клиника) has null values for offers_aligners/offers_braces/offers_implants - old form submission

passed_tests: Page /admin/clinic-applications loads correctly with admin authentication
Redirects to /admin login if no token in localStorage
Table displays applications with columns: clinic_name, city, contact_name, services (as tags), status (as badges), date
Status filter cards show correct counts: All(5), Pending(2), Approved(1), Rejected(1), Waiting List(0)
Search filters by clinic name, contact name, city, or email
Clicking a row opens detail modal with all submitted data
Detail modal shows Clinic Info section (name, city, address, website)
Detail modal shows Contact section (contact person, phone, email)
Detail modal shows Services & Patients section (toggles as colored dots)
Detail modal shows Qualification section (years experience, cases/month, digital scans)
Detail modal shows Positioning & Operations section (patient types, response time)
Status buttons in detail modal: Pending/Approved/Rejected/Waiting List all clickable
Clicking status button updates status via PATCH /api/admin/clinic-applications/{id}
Admin notes textarea with Save button stores notes via PATCH endpoint
Backend PATCH correctly updates only status and notes fields
Backend PATCH returns 400 for invalid fields (e.g., clinic_name)
Backend PATCH returns 404 for non-existent application
Navigation header has 'Клиники' link from dashboard to clinic-applications page
GET /api/admin/clinic-applications returns all applications sorted by created_at descending
Admin login returns 'access_token' (not 'token') - correctly handled by frontend

critical_code_review_comments: Frontend page.tsx well-structured with proper data-testid attributes for all interactive elements

Frontend correctly stores admin_token in localStorage and uses Bearer token for API calls
Detail modal is scrollable and shows all sections with proper organization
Status badges use appropriate colors (amber=pending, green=approved, red=rejected, sky=waiting_list)
Service tags displayed as small pills with correct labels (Алайнери, Брекети, Импланти)
